name: Walkure-A Slave
original_name: ワルキューレAスレイブ
source:
The noble blonde European girl Celia is an exchange student 
studying at this beautiful euroscape like academic town of Winford.

Unaware of the dangers that lurk in the shadows...

Her professor, a big c*cked, unparalleled warrior in the bed 
has set his eyes on her and he's not one to give up easily...
A professional at 'training' women and their bodies, Celia never 
stood a chance. The moment she was caught in his web of 
entanglement... it was all over!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE197770.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
高贵的金发欧洲女孩Celia是交换生 
在温福德这个美丽的欧洲风景如学术小镇学习。

却没有意识到隐藏在阴影中的危险……

她的教授，一个大屌，床上无与伦比的战士 
他的目光已经落在了她的身上，他不是一个可以轻易放弃的人……
西莉亚是一位“训练”女性及其身体的专业人士，她从不 
有机会。当她陷入他的罗网的那一刻 
纠缠……一切都结束了！
